title.en: Hunayn’s Latin afterlife: text and marginal notes
title.zh: 侯奈因的拉丁文传播：正文与边注

alt.en: A vellum leaf carries dense dark Gothic lettering, large red initials and smaller handwritten notes along the margins.
alt.zh: 羊皮纸页上密布深色哥特字体，有大型红色首字母，页边另有较小手写注释。

caption.en: Isagoge in Tegni Galeni, attributed to Johannitius (Hunayn ibn Ishaq); early-fourteenth-century manuscript, Wellcome MS.390, leaf 1r.
caption.zh: 《盖伦医术导论》，归于约翰尼提乌斯（侯奈因·伊本·伊斯哈格）；十四世纪初手稿，惠康MS.390，第1叶正面。

interpretation.en: Red headings and marginal annotations show a later setting for reading a medical text transmitted under Hunayn’s Latin name. This medieval copy is centuries later than Hunayn, not his handwriting.
interpretation.zh: 红色标题和边注呈现以侯奈因拉丁名传播的医学文本如何被后世阅读。此中世纪抄本比侯奈因晚数百年，并非他的手迹。

items.creator: Unrecorded scribe; text attributed to Johannitius

title.en: Plant forms in a later Bencao Gangmu edition
title.zh: 后世《本草纲目》版本中的植物形态

alt.en: Four rectangular panels on a yellowed book page show leafy plants with bulbs, roots and flowers, each accompanied by Chinese characters.
alt.zh: 泛黄书页以四个矩形栏展示带叶、鳞茎、根或花的植物，各栏附有汉字。

caption.en: Plant illustrations from an 1883 edition of Li Shizhen’s Bencao Gangmu; Wellcome Collection, L0022166. Photograph supplied under CC BY 4.0.
caption.zh: 李时珍《本草纲目》1883年版本中的植物图；惠康收藏L0022166。照片依CC BY 4.0提供。

interpretation.en: The page organizes plants as labelled visual comparisons. This nineteenth-century edition shows the work’s continued circulation after its first publication in 1596, rather than the manuscript completed by Li Shizhen.
interpretation.zh: 此页以带标签的图栏组织植物比较。十九世纪版本展现著作自1596年首刊后的持续流传，而非李时珍完成的原稿。

items.creator: Illustrators and photographer unrecorded; work compiled by Li Shizhen

note.en: Wellcome’s item-specific image record assigns CC BY 4.0 and requests credit to Wellcome Collection. Image unchanged.
note.zh: 惠康单件图像记录指定CC BY 4.0，并要求署名惠康收藏。图像未经更改。

transformation.en: Official IIIF derivative saved unchanged, retaining the page edges and existing photographic crop.
transformation.zh: 原样保存官方IIIF衍生图，保留纸边与原有摄影取景。
